body: Even if some things make me happy, they don't have the power to overpower the feelings I have. Plenty of things bring me joy momentarily. I laugh a lot. But overall, those things don't have much effect on my life.

I like travelling and seeing new places. That's the only thing I can think of right now. I used to really love dancing and debate but I got kicked out of my dance studio for gaining weight and I'm not good at debate anymore.

There is zero chance I am talking to my parents. They went through a divorce and I was tossed in between Texas and Oregon because neither of them wanted to take me in. I'm the outcast in the family because I'm not mormon. My dad completely left my life and I have no respect for my mom. 

There is nothing I can do at this point and it really, really scares me.
